invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The SKU of a product must be unique across all products in the inventory.
The stock quantity of a product must be non-negative.
The price of a product must be a positive value.
When a product is updated, its SKU must remain unchanged if it is already assigned.
A product search operation must return only products that match the specified name or category.
Category filtering must return only products that belong to the specified category.
Low-stock reporting must identify products with a stock quantity less than or equal to 10.
Adding a product with a SKU that already exists in the inventory must fail.
Deleting a product must remove it from the inventory and update any dependent operations accordingly.
The total number of products in the inventory must remain consistent across all CRUD operations and queries.
